newsitem.title: GERMANY: German CDU group plans to amend tax reform plan.
newsitem.headline: German CDU group plans to amend tax reform plan.

text.p: Some members of Germany's ruling Christian Democrats (CDU) hope to amend the party's tax reform plans at its annual conference in Hanover this week, the Handelsblatt newspaper reported on Sunday.

In a summary of an article to appear in Monday's edition, the paper said members of the CDU's economics sub-committee expressed concern about plans to tax share market investments as well as differences in property taxation.

The group hopes to give capital investment bonuses to those living in western Germany as well as eastern Germany while the current reform plan envisions capital investment bonuses only for those living eastern Germany.
